method.update: Q(s,a) += alpha * (r + gamma * max_a' Q(s',a') - Q(s,a)); target = r if terminal
method.action_selection: epsilon-greedy while training; greedy (epsilon=0) when playing this GIF

features.name: danger
features.meaning: wall/body danger as 3 bits: straight*4 + left*2 + right (0..7)

features.name: apple_dir
features.meaning: apple relative to head: rowSign*3 + colSign (row: 0 above/1 same/2 below; col: 0 left/1 same/2 right)

features.name: heading
features.meaning: current heading (0 up, 1 right, 2 down, 3 left)

features.name: length_bucket
features.meaning: snake length bucket (0 SHORT, 1 MEDIUM, 2 LONG, 3 XLONG); thresholds = fraction of board area (0.1, 0.25, 0.5)
